scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-heading font-extrabold tracking-tighter leading-tight drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(217,70,239,0.3)]
scale.small_accent: text-xs font-body uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-cyan-400 font-semibold

typography.general_rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep tight letter spacing for headings and generous line height for body.

colors.rules: Dark theme by default. Tint neutral grays with blue/purple to match the neon vibe. Avoid pure black (#000000).

visual_enhancers.depth: Use layered glassmorphism. Surfaces should be separated by 1px solid semi-transparent borders and subtle colored drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise/grain overlay (opacity 3-5%) on the main background to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.neon_glow: Apply soft radial background gradients (bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))]) using primary/secondary colors at 15-20% opacity to simulate ambient neon light behind key sections (like hero image and product grids).

layouts.grid_strategy: Bento Grid protocol. Use wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8). Product catalog should use responsive grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 for major sections. Inner padding for cards should be p-6 or p-8.
layouts.hero_structure: Split layout. Left: Typography, CTA, metrics. Right: High-impact real woman photo spanning full height with gradient fade on the left edge.

components.header: Crystal Glass style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#05050A]/70 border-b border-white/10. Include Wallet balance prominently (e.g., in a neon-bordered pill).
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary button: bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-500 to-purple-600 hover:from-fuchsia-400 hover:to-purple-500 text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(217,70,239,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(217,70,239,0.6)] transition-all duration-300. Secondary: border border-cyan-500 text-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-500/10.
components.cards: Dark surface bg-[#0C0C14] border border-white/5 hover:border-fuchsia-500/50 rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_10px_30px_-10px_rgba(217,70,239,0.3)].
components.chips_categories: Rounded-full px-4 py-2 border border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-sm font-medium transition-colors. Active state: bg-cyan-500/20 border-cyan-500 text-cyan-300.
components.inputs: bg-[#0C0C14] border-white/10 focus:border-fuchsia-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-fuchsia-500 text-white rounded-lg.
components.dialogs: Glassmorphic overlay (backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/60). Dialog content bg-[#0C0C14] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl shadow-purple-900/20.

motion.framer_motion: Use Framer Motion for entrance animations (y: 20, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5, staggerChildren).
motion.floating_elements: For the hero likes/followers popups, use animate={{ y: [0, -10, 0] }} transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 3, ease: 'easeInOut' }}.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for testimonials. Slow speed (speed={30}), pauseOnHover={true}, gradient={true} gradientColor={[5, 5, 10]}.

media.hero_integration: The main hero image MUST be the real photo of a woman provided in image_urls. Do not use AI generated images. Implement as a foreground image layered over a neon radial gradient background. Apply a left-to-right gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#05050A] via-[#05050A]/70 to-transparent) to ensure the left-aligned text is perfectly readable. Add floating 'likes', 'hearts', and 'followers' popup badges (glassmorphic pills, e.g., '👍 1.2k', '❤️', '👤 +500') around the subject using Framer Motion to simulate social media growth.
media.image_grading: Keep the natural photo but ensure it blends with the dark theme. The provided image already has neon lighting. Do NOT apply heavy grayscale; let the neon pink/cyan pop.

hero.description: Smiling female influencer with glasses illuminated by neon pink and blue lights. Use as the main hero image.

placeholders.description: For product packages, use relevant high-quality Unsplash images representing social media (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube icons/abstracts) or neon abstract shapes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast ratios against the dark background. Specifically, cyan and fuchsia text must be light enough.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-fuchsia-500 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='wallet-balance').

instructions_to_main_agent: Rebuild all components using .jsx or .js extensions.
Apply the global CSS variables to the Tailwind entry CSS file.
Integrate Lucide-React icons for UI elements and social platforms.
Implement the Hero section with the exact Unsplash image provided, including the floating Framer Motion badges.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them with the dark neon theme, removing the default 'Vercel' look.
For the Testimonials Marquee, use react-fast-marquee and style the testimonial cards with the glassmorphism/card rules.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for the header or dialogs; always use backdrop-blur and semi-transparent dark colors.
The top-up page should have simulated payment methods presented as polished neon-accented bento cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Opt for asymmetrical or strong left-aligned layouts for text.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphic backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for icons. Use Lucide icons.
